data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic and reflect a high-quality, family-run business. The minor clustering of recent 5-star reviews is offset by detailed, varied content spanning years, specific crew names, proactive service practices, and consistent high ratings across platforms with no substantive complaints.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews posted within a 2-week period (clustering)

positive_evidence: Proactive communication during inclement weather to avoid equipment damage
Rescued pool equipment after a winter freeze
Consistent, reliable service treating pool 'as if it was their own'

authentic_signals: Specific details: owner Alex, son Vinny, service manager Vinny, cleaner Jose, winter storm check-ins, photo updates, filter cleaning schedules
Mention of switching from other companies
Mix of recent and older reviews (2 weeks to 2 years)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are highly consistent across Google (4.9) and Yelp (4.8). BBB rating of 'A' with no complaints aligns with positive customer feedback.

reviews.text:
Alex and his son Vinny at Waterfalls Pool Services LLC have been taking care of our pool, and their service has been excellent. They are professional, responsive, and truly care about doing the job right. Communication is always clear, they show up on time, and our pool has been in great condition since they started maintaining it.

It’s rare to find a family-owned business that takes this much pride in their work. Alex and Vinny are honest, reliable, and very easy to work with. I really appreciate their attention to detail and friendly attitude.

Highly recommend Waterfalls Pool Services to anyone looking for dependable and high-quality pool maintenance.
reviews.author: Donnie Ray

reviews.text: I can’t say enough great things about Waterfalls Pool Services. The owner, Alex, has consistently been highly attentive to the needs of our pool and is always very quick to respond. His level of professionalism is unmatched. He also has an awesome team behind him including his service manager, Vinny, and our pool cleaner, Jose. They always promptly stick to our weekly schedule and leave our pool sparkling clean after every visit. I highly recommend Waterfalls Pool Services. Thank you, Alex and team!
reviews.author: William Rowe

reviews.text:
Alex and team have been a tremendous help with their pool maintenance and repair services!
After having used a few different companies in the past, Waterfalls pool service is the one that I will continue to stick with as the have been the most reliable, friendly, and trustworthy in servicing our pool and answering all of our questions.

They even messaged to check in on us and our pool during this winter storm which was a really nice gesture!
reviews.author: Faiz Patel

reviews.text: I switched pool companies to Waterfalls about six months ago and I have never been happier! The service consistent, reliable, and I feel like they treat my pool as if it was their own. I really love the personal touch that they provide and how they keep me informed on any issues or concerns they have. I highly recommend their services!!
reviews.author: Christine McGowan

reviews.text: Waterfall Pool Service has been fantastic to work with. They are extremely timely, communicative, and always check in when bad weather hits to make sure everything is okay. It’s such a relief to have a company that is proactive and truly cares about their customers. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Lori Appleby

reviews.text: They have been servicing our pool and they are top notch out of all companies and this includes other industries. Their communication is a 10 out of 10 we receive reminders when they will be coming and then follow up photos and details of the service they provided.  They also do check-ins during winter storms to make sure equipment is running properly.  Can’t ask for a better company.  Plumbing, electricians and HVAC need to follow Waterfalls service model.
reviews.author: Joe D

reviews.text: Mister Alex is very professional and respectful person. He help us with a lot of questions about our pool and gave us a special estimate for an our needs. A company and a person that you can Trust. We really appreciate do business with Waterfalls Pool Service.
reviews.author: Marcos Salina

reviews.text: Waterfalls doesn’t just clean the pool.  The technicians “take care” of the pool.  I appreciate the pictures after cleaning to show the pool’s condition, the time taken while on site to ensure the system is working well, and the proactive communication during inclement weather to avoid equipment damage.  Highly recommend this company!
reviews.author: C Greene

reviews.text: Alex from Waterfalls Pool Service has been helping me take care of my swimming pool and equipment for two years. He is always helpful and always willing to help whether it’s to clean the filter, pool, or the maintain the equipment. He put my pool filter on cleaning schedule to maintain its cleanliness. He is reliable, trustworthy, and full of knowledge. We appreciate their team for their services
reviews.author: Rog E

reviews.text:
I just have to give a shoutout to the incredible team at Waterfalls Pool Services, who not only rescued my pool equipment after a winter freeze but also handle our weekly pool maintenance with unmatched friendliness and expertise!

When the winter freeze caused issues with my pool equipment, I reached out to Waterfalls Pool Services, and they were on it like pool superheroes. Their response was not only quick but also delivered with a level of friendliness that turned a potentially stressful situation into a positive experience.

Now, on top of their fantastic repair services, we've been relying on Waterfalls Pool Services for our weekly pool maintenance, and let me tell you, they consistently go above and beyond. The team takes care of everything, from skimming the surface to maintaining the chemical balance, ensuring our pool is always in tip-top shape.

And here's the best part—they make it all affordable. Dealing with unexpected repairs can be a headache, but Waterfalls Pool Services has a fair and transparent pricing structure that keeps it all budget-friendly. Their commitment to affordability without sacrificing quality is truly commendable.

Throughout both the repair and maintenance services, their communication has been outstanding. It's not just about business; it feels like chatting with friends who happen to be pool experts. The friendly conversations and expert advice make every interaction a pleasure.

So, if you're on the lookout for a pool service that combines friendliness, affordability, and unmatched expertise, Waterfalls Pool Services is the way to go. I wholeheartedly recommend them for both repairs and weekly maintenance—you won't be disappointed!
reviews.author: Evelyn Finister

reviews.text: Alex and his team do an awesome job keeping our pool crystal clear and are super responsive to issues or repairs when they come up.  I highly recommend them for all pool maintenance and repair needs!
reviews.author: Jared Lee

reviews.text: Alex and his team do a great job with the weekly maintenance of my pool. They started in March 2025 when I was in a bad spot after surgery. I could no longer do my own maintenance. Alex came to review my pool a day after my call and set up weekly maintenance the next day. Great service and a nice man as well. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Bob M

reviews.text: I highly recommend Alex. I texted him in the morning to come and clean my pool filter. He    came the same day and did a wonderful job. Alex took pictures of his work and showed me what he cleaned. I highly recommend his company!!
reviews.author: Tetyana Markovska

reviews.text: Since 2011 Alex has been maintaining our pool since then his company has grown reason is simple his honesty uncompromising customer services i recommend his services
reviews.author: Avi Dandiya

reviews.text: This company is great. Kelby is incredible. He comes with high energy. Does his job thoroughly with a great attitude, and leaves the pool looking spectacular.
reviews.author: TKIND3R

reviews.text: I have been using this service for over two years, the service is very reliable and comprehensive, you could count on the service for any pool related issues.
reviews.author: John H.

reviews.text: Alex and his team do amazing work! We needed our pool retiled and Alex took care of it! He sent us tile samples to look at, put a quote together to review easily and got the work done so quickly! The quality of work is outstanding and we're so happy with how it turned out. Alex and team are great to work with and will continue to utilize them for all our pool needs.
reviews.author: Rachel Davis

reviews.text: Alex always does an amazing job cleaning our pool filter. In addition, he provides good tips on how to best maintain our pool, pipes and filter especially given that we have 5 mature oak trees surrounding our pool that drop catskins every spring. It makes for a very dirty filter, to say the least. Alex is also a great communicator and has such a great disposition about him that the customer service piece further solidifies our loyalty to having him as the only one we feel confident in servicing our pool. Please see before & after photos of Alex’s tremendous work!
reviews.author: Laura Cole Nevarez

reviews.text: Alex did an amazing job cleaning our pool. It was in a rough shape but it looks great now! He responded quickly, showed up on time and handled every issue right away. He explained everything clearly and was very polite. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Neelima Meruva

reviews.text: Excellent service.  I would highly recommend Waterfalls Pool Service.  They have done several projects on our pool and I can’t say anything negative about the quality or function of their work.   Alex is super responsive, communicative, and does what he says he is going to do.  They are prices competitivly as well.  In a world of scammers and fly by night companies, you can trust Alex.   Great company!!!
reviews.author: Matthew Ryan

reviews.text:
Quick update:  I still love Waterfalls pool service!  Highly recommend

I couldn’t be happier with Waterfalls Pool Services.  They do excellent work and are incredibly easy to work with.  Alex is reliable, professional, and truly cares about his customers.  Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Jim Lamb

reviews.text: Waterfall Pool offers amazing service! They are on time, meticulous and very reasonably priced. Alexander took his time explaining in detail what he offered and he has delivered!
reviews.author: A Delgado

reviews.text: Awesome pool company!  We have used other pool services but Waterfalls Pool Services is above reproach.  They are punctual and dependable.  They send a text before they arrive which allows us time to put our dogs inside.  They have helped us with needed repairs in a timely fashion.  Our pool is always sparkling and ready to use.  Their rates are also very competitive.  Stop the search and give them a try!
reviews.author: Alanea Mleczko

reviews.text: I switched to waterfall pool service last fall. I’ve been really pleased with the customer service and attention to keep my pool in good order. Their weekly service is very thorough and all the items are given adequate attention. No skipping steps like the last company. Through the cold winter freezes they routinely checked on items and were helpful to answer any questions I had and made a few special visits to take care of any items that came up. They were helpful to prevent any major repairs necessary. I’m glad we switched to Waterfall pool service. Worth the switch for improved service and better cost.
reviews.author: Mayumi Arcand

reviews.text: Alex from Waterfall Pools came out and serviced our pool pump. He did a great job, not only cleaned and serviced the pump and filter, but left the area very tidy. Responsible, conscientious and trustworthy, we will work with him again.
reviews.author: Laura Gallagher

reviews.text: Alex was super responsive from day 1, provided detailed updates every visit & was very flexible and easy to work with.
reviews.author: Alvin Methoth

reviews.text: Great pool service! Super responsive owner, fast feedback, and excellent pool maintenance.
reviews.author: DANNY SEO

reviews.text:
I needed multiple things done on my pool and equipment. I found Alex online and from the first call, I was extremely impressed.
Alex is very responsive and he has exceeded all my expectations.
His tech fixed my aqualink system which has been malfunctioning for years now.
Very professional, friendly and honest.
Thanks Alex!
reviews.author: Steve Eulenberg
